a.description: first input array with any shape.

b.description: second input array with any shape.

output.description: A new array representing the Kronecker product of the inputs ``a`` and ``b``. The shape of the output is the element-wise product of the input shapes.

constraints: a and b must have broadcastable shapes
output shape: (m * p, n * q) where a shape: (m, n), b shape: (p, q)
